"# Tasks

- [x] Gate Search Bar Inputs in Combined and Separate Views (`search_table`, `search_by_code`, `search_by_name`, `delete_search`)
- [x] Gate Table Status Reservation in Table Context Menu (`table_reservation`)
- [x] Gate Sync Buttons on Receipts Page (`sync_button`)
- [x] Gate Save & Print Settle Checkout Actions (`enable_save_settle`, `enable_print_settle`)
  - [x] Update checkout buttons in Billing pane footer
  - [x] Enforce checks at the top of `handleCheckout`
  - [x] Enforce checks in keyboard shortcuts handler
- [x] Gate Base Price and Initial Stock Qty in Local Item Config Form (`change_item_price`, `update_stock`)
- [x] Filter categories and table departments in sidebar, item grid, and table layouts (`getAllowedCategories`, `getAllowedDepartments`)
- [x] Verify build compiles correctly with `npm run build`
- [x] Rebuild Electron installer and win-unpacked package

## Quick Bill Customization
- [x] Hide the `Order/KOT` and `Billing` sub-tabs in Quick Bill mode (`orderType === 'QUICK'`)
- [x] Add React state bindings (`quickBillPrintKot` and `quickBillPrintBill`) for Quick Bill checkboxes
- [x] Sync checkbox states with default preferences (`posSettings.quickBillDefaultKOTPrint` and `posSettings.quickBillDefaultBillPrint`)
- [x] Implement dual printing (KOT first, then Bill) in Quick Bill settlement if KOT checkbox is checked
- [x] Prevent printing KOT if unchecked, and only print the bill
- [x] Update local shift sales and item stock correctly upon Quick Bill settlement
- [x] Reset billing view to `'menu'` instead of `'tables'` when Quick Bill / Pickup orders are settled
- [x] Verify compilation and build output with Vite

## Pre-Order Adjustments
- [x] Save customer details automatically to local DB and server when booking/updating pre-orders
- [x] Load active pre-orders on startup (`initApp`) and represent them as temporary tables in the tables view
- [x] Load the pre-order details, customer name/phone, advance, and cart items when clicking a pre-order temporary tabl
